Post-order Traversal of Binary Tree

Problem Statement:
Write a program to perform post-order traversal of a binary tree. The traversal should follow Left → Right → Root order.

Description:
The program will read the binary tree in level order. Use -1 to represent a NULL node. Build the binary tree from the input and then print its post-order traversal sequence.

Input Format:

First line: Integer n — number of nodes (including NULLs as -1 in level order).

Second line: n space-separated integers representing the node values in level order (-1 for NULL).

Output Format:

Single line: Post-order traversal sequence (space-separated).
